name: Regent Porto Montenegro
insider_take: This ultra-luxe marina resort sits on a former naval base turned into Montenegro's most exclusive superyacht destination.
whats_special: The hotel occupies a transformed Austro-Hungarian naval facility dating back to 1889, now home to the largest superyacht marina on the Adriatic. The striking Venetian-inspired architecture houses just 87 rooms and suites, making it one of the region's most intimate luxury properties. The location offers direct access to Porto Montenegro's designer boutiques, Michelin-level dining, and private yacht charters.
pro_tip: Book a bay-view suite during summer to watch the spectacular superyacht arrivals and departures - some vessels exceed 100 meters and cost more than small countries' GDP.
dont_miss: The Naval Heritage Collection showcasing the site's maritime history, sunset cocktails at the rooftop bar overlooking Boka Bay (one of Europe's southernmost fjords), and a day trip to nearby Sveti Stefan - the iconic fortified island village that's appeared in countless films and served as a playground for Hollywood royalty.
pros: Luxury marina setting with yacht access and Adriatic Sea views
Exceptional dining experiences with Mediterranean cuisine
Premium location in Montenegro's exclusive Porto Montenegro development
cons: Limited nearby attractions outside the marina complex
